title: Connect a LinkedIn member
description: RecruitOps uses LinkedIn's official authorization-code flow with OpenID profile access and Share on LinkedIn. Access tokens stay server-side and are encrypted before durable storage.
reconnectRequired: Reconnect required before publishing can continue.
noAccounts: No LinkedIn member is connected yet.
connectedNotice: LinkedIn authorization completed and the member connection was refreshed.
deniedNotice: LinkedIn authorization was cancelled. No account was changed.
loadFailed: RecruitOps could not load LinkedIn accounts. Try refreshing.
startFailed: RecruitOps could not start LinkedIn authorization. Check the server configuration and try again.
missingApiConfig: The frontend API connection is not configured.
ownerAdminRequired: Only OWNER and ADMIN accounts can manage LinkedIn connections.
